systemUrl.title: OParl system URL
systemUrl.description: The OParl entry point of one municipality, e.g. https://ratsinformation.stadt-koeln.de/oparl/system

collections.title: Collections to read
collections.description: Any of: organizations, people, locations, meetings, agendas, papers, drafts, files, committees, participations, elections

maxItems.title: Maximum items per collection
maxItems.description: Maximum records to return per collection. Each page fetched counts against the run, so keep this small when testing an endpoint.

pageSize.title: Page size
pageSize.description: Records per request where the server accepts a page size; ignored where it does not (measured: SD.NET RIM refuses it with HTTP 400).
